title: Self-Receiving
speaker: Heigaku Talus Latona
summary: The talk's main teaching is that true understanding and enlightenment come not from trying to control or change our experiences, but rather from embracing and accepting them exactly as they are. This means letting go of our need for a fixed sense of self and instead allowing phenomena to manifest and reveal themselves in the present moment, without judgment or resistance. By doing so, we can tap into a deeper reality that is beyond words and concepts, and find freedom and peace in the midst of life's challenges.

Addressing these responsibilities does require acting with compassion in the moment, aided by training and compassion to be able to be aware of the moment. But how does living authentically in the moment allow us to plan for the future?

And if we don't plan for the future, how can we make real progress on righting wrongs and changing what needs to be changed? That will require some moments when we set aside all else and dive fully into the present moment of envisioning the future. I look forward to having that conversation together. May our intentions equally extend to every being and place with the true merit of the Buddha's way. Beings are numberless. I vow to save them. Delusions are inexhaustible. I vow to end them. Dharma gates are boundless. I vow to enter them. Buddha's way is unsurpassable. I vow to become it.
